description: Invoke a method on a specific node (RPC routed through the gateway). Wraps `node.invoke`. Mutates depending on the target method.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

params.description: JSON-RPC params — opaque passthrough to the target node method. Shape depends on the method being invoked.

name: openclaw_node_invoke
